description: This file contains the PHP class OrderStatus within the namespace Opencart.Catalog.Model.Localisation. It defines methods to retrieve order status details and listings from a database in the context of the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: Defines methods for accessing order status information from the database, including retrieving a specific order status by ID and fetching all order statuses.

methods.name: getOrderStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a specific order status record by its ID, filtering by the current language ID.

methods.name: getOrderStatuses
methods.description: Fetches all order statuses available for the current language, utilizing caching for efficiency.
